purpose: Separate public availability, methodological adequacy and reuse basis for reconstructed historical poll facts. This is an evidence-control policy, not a legal determination.

explicit_open_licence.meaning: The source expressly grants a reusable licence covering the relevant data.
explicit_open_licence.replayEligibility: possible when provenance and model-field gates pass

permission_obtained.meaning: Documented permission covers the project use.

official_open_data.meaning: An official open-data source supplies the factual observation.

independently_reconstructed_factual_obse.meaning: Only model-required factual fields are transcribed from an attributable contemporaneous source; no authored compilation or unnecessary source expression is copied.
independently_reconstructed_factual_obse.rawSourceStorage: not required; retain URL, fingerprint and retrieval metadata instead
independently_reconstructed_factual_obse.factualTranscription: permitted as structured facts, subject to project-owner review
independently_reconstructed_factual_obse.replayEligibility: possible only when provenance and methodological gates pass and the record is manually approved
independently_reconstructed_factual_obse.attribution: stable source, availability date, retrieval date and fingerprint required
independently_reconstructed_factual_obse.redistribution: structured facts only; do not redistribute source text or report layout

research_only.meaning: Useful for discovery or analysis but not approved as a reusable project input.

third_party_dataset_unlicensed.meaning: An authored compilation has no established reuse basis.
third_party_dataset_unlicensed.attribution: dataset fingerprint and quarantine record required

unknown.manualReview: required to resolve, not to bypass
